column1: # THE WITNESS BINDING TABLE FOR THE CORRECTION VERIFIER.
# One row per PREDECESSOR criterion AC01..AC50. Every field is
#   frozen_phase        the predecessor Q0 frozen roster.
#   cited_witness       the predecessor ledger cited path.
#   cited_present       the cited path EXISTS in the predecessor
#   cited_phase_valid   the cited path was committed AT OR BEFORE
#   cited_carries       the cited witness MATCHES the frozen
#   binding_artifact    the artifact that ACTUALLY discharges the
#                       frozen predicate. NONE when no artifact
#   binding_present     the binding artifact EXISTS in the close tree.
#   binding_phase_valid the binding artifact is at a valid phase.
#   binding_carries     the binding artifact carries the frozen
#   verified_status     the reconciled verdict, which is the
# A criterion may be adjudicated PROVEN only when it has a binding
# artifact that is present, phase-valid and carries the subject.
# A criterion that is NOT proven has NO binding artifact, even when
# the intermediate alternate-witness search proposed one.
